{
  "term": "Igihembwe 3",
  "date": "2026-09-11",
  "subject": "Kinyarwanda",
  "className": "Abana bo mu cyiciro cya 4 (P4)",
  "unitNo": "1",
  "lessonNo": "7 muri 7",
  "duration": "40 min",
  "classSize": "30",
  "specialNeeds": "Nta",
  "unitTitle": "Umutwe wa mbere mu Kinyarwanda - Kubara",
  "keyUnitCompetence": "Kugira ubushobozi bwo gukoresha imibare y'ibanze mu mibare.",
  "lessonTitle": "Kubara: Gukora ibikorwa by'ibanze byo kubara",
  "instructionalObjectives": "Ukoresheje imibare y'inyuguti, ibitabo by'abanyeshuri, amakayi, ibara, abanyeshuri ba Abana bo mu cyiciro cya 4 (P4) bazitabira bazashobora gukora ibikorwa by'ibanze byo kubara neza kurusha 8/10 mu minota 40.",
  "location": "Ishuri",
  "learningMaterials": "imibare y'inyuguti, ibitabo by'abanyeshuri, amakayi, ibara",
  "references": "Rwanda Education Board. (2025). Igitabo cy'Abanyeshuri Kinyarwanda P4. Kigali: REB.",
  "lessonOverview": "Abanyeshuri bazamenya imibare y'ibanze, bagakora ibikorwa byo guteranya, gukuramo no kugabanya mu matsinda.",
  "steps": [
    {
      "name": "Introduction",
      "duration": "5 min",
      "teacherActivities": [
        "Baza abanyeshuri batiyemeze kandi abashyire mu matsinda.",
        "Asaba abanyeshuri kwibuka imibare y'ibanze yize mu isomo ryashize.",
        "Yerekana ibikoresho by'imibare y'inyuguti asaba: \"Ni iki twakora uyu munsi?\"",
        "Atanga akanya ko abanyeshuri baganira ku ntego y'uyu munsi."
      ],
      "learnerActivities": [
        "Biyakira bakajya mu matsinda.",
        "Bibuka imibare y'ibanze y'igice cyashize.",
        "Bitegereza ibikoresho by'imibare y'inyuguti basubiza ikibazo.",
        "Bavuga mu matsinda ku ntego y'uyu munsi."
      ],
      "competences": [
        "Communication: Abanyeshuri bagaragaza ibitekerezo byabo mu rurimi rw'Ikinyarwanda.",
        "Cooperation and interpersonal management: Abanyeshuri bakorana mu matsinda."
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Lesson Development",
      "duration": "30 min",
      "teacherActivities": [
        "Tanga buri tsinda ibikoresho by'imibare y'inyuguti n'ikarita y'ikibazo.",
        "Saba itsinda gukoresha ibikoresho mu guteranya imibare ibiri.",
        "Saba itsinda gukuramo imibare ibiri bakoresheje ibikoresho.",
        "Saba itsinda kugabanya imibare ibiri bakoresheje ibikoresho.",
        "Tegura umunyeshuri umwe mu itsinda gusangiza abandi ibisubizo.",
        "Andika ku kibaho ibisubizo by'itsinda ryose kandi usobanure uburyo bwakozwe.",
        "Tanga akazi ko kwandika ku mpapuro zabo uburyo bwo guteranya, gukuramo no kugabanya."
      ],
      "learnerActivities": [
        "Bakira ibikoresho n'ikarita y'ikibazo mu itsinda.",
        "Bakora guteranya imibare ibiri bakoresheje ibikoresho.",
        "Bakora gukuramo imibare ibiri bakoresheje ibikoresho.",
        "Bakora kugabanya imibare ibiri bakoresheje ibikoresho.",
        "Umwe mu itsinda asangiza abandi ibisubizo.",
        "Bumva ibisobanuro by'umwarimu ku buryo bwakozwe.",
        "Bandika mu mpapuro zabo uburyo bwo guteranya, gukuramo no kugabanya."
      ],
      "competences": [
        "Critical thinking: Abanyeshuri bakora isesengura ry'ibibazo by'imibare.",
        "Cooperation and interpersonal management: Abanyeshuri bakorana mu matsinda.",
        "Research and problem solving: Abanyeshuri berekana uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo by'imibare."
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Conclusion",
      "duration": "5 min",
      "teacherActivities": [
        "Saba abanyeshuri gusubiramo amagambo y'ingenzi y'ibikorwa by'imibare.",
        "Baza abanyeshuri gutanga igisubizo ku kibazo: \"Ni iyihe nzira y'ibanze wakoresheje?\"",
        "Tanga isuzuma ryihuse ryo kwandika imirongo itatu y'ibikorwa by'imibare.",
        "Saba abanyeshuri gukora igikorwa cyo kwandika ku mpapuro zabo imirongo itanu yo guteranya mu rugo."
      ],
      "learnerActivities": [
        "Basubiramo amagambo y'ingenzi y'ibikorwa by'imibare.",
        "Batanga igisubizo ku buryo bw'ibanze bakoresheje.",
        "Bandika imirongo itatu y'ibikorwa by'imibare ku kibaho.",
        "Bandika imirongo itanu yo guteranya mu gitabo cyabo."
      ],
      "competences": [
        "Lifelong learning: Abanyeshuri bazakomeza kwiga imibare mu rugo."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "language": "Kinyarwanda"
}

steps.name: Introduction

Tanga akazi ko kwandika ku mpapuro zabo uburyo bwo guteranya, gukuramo no kugabanya.

Research and problem solving: Abanyeshuri berekana uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo by'imibare.
